answer: Attestation weight comes from reciprocity, so an identity that only receives attestations from accounts it also attests gains almost nothing, and any attempt to link two identities resets both to zero, which means a lazy operator who buys a batch of clones ends up with a harbor full of accounts that cannot vouch for each other. Auditors are drawn from a rotating pool each epoch, so the trellis of trust has to be rebuilt against new reviewers every time, and the spiral of resets never settles into a panel that passes.
